preview.text: Wellington won the toss and chose to bowl first against Canterbury in a one-day match at Basin Reserve. The usual first-innings score in the 6 recorded one-day matches at Basin Reserve is 256. The forecast for the next 8 hours calls for up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 13 degrees.

summary.text: Canterbury won by 209 runs. CNTBRY made 350-5, Henry Nicholls (c) top-scoring with 119 off 121 balls; Yahya Zeb took 4 for 63. WEL made 141-10, Gareth Severin top-scoring with 55 off 80 balls; Raunaq Kapur took 3 for 19. Sides batting first at Basin Reserve usually make about 256.
